sourcePrompt: A volunteer walking group needs a one-page printed notice that tells newcomers where and when to meet and what to bring. Recommend how to arrange the supplied confirmed meeting details and existing bring-list on that one page. Do not add a second page or assume a website link can replace printed essentials.

facts.text: The required output is one printed page with confirmed meeting details and an existing bring-list. Their exact contents are not supplied.
Maya proposes putting meeting details at the top so a newcomer can find them quickly.
Noah proposes a short checklist for what to bring, using the existing list.
Maya explicitly supports keeping the checklist. Noah supports prominent meeting details but asks whether both will remain readable on one page.
No final layout has been checked or adopted. No notice has been distributed.

unknowns: Actual length of the supplied details and bring-list
Whether a proposed layout is readable on one page
